notes.3: This question was challenging for many candidates. notes.7: Most candidates failed to read this question carefully and chose option C , giving the spring’s length rather than its extension.
notes.12: This question on pressure was generally well answered, although many candidates chose B , presumably believing that the heels were shown from the side, and not as stated in the question.
